name: Granular
blurb: Chops audio into tiny grains, then stretches, pitches and reorders them into clouds, pads and textures.

name: Glitch & Time
blurb: Stutters, reverses, tape stops and deliberate instability. Effects built to break things on purpose.

name: Spectral
blurb: Works on the harmonics and frequency bins themselves (FFT), not only the waveform.

name: AI & Generative
blurb: Machine learning or generative engines that invent sounds, patches or patterns for you.

name: Physical Modeling
blurb: Simulates vibrating strings, plates, springs and resonators mathematically, with no samples involved.

name: Creative Samplers
blurb: Samplers that slice, stretch, layer and randomize instead of just playing the file back.

name: Weird Modulation
blurb: Unusual sequencers, multiband modulators and movement generators.

name: Lo-fi & Character
blurb: Tape, degradation, saturation and sound with a personality.

name: Odd Synths
blurb: Synthesizers with unconventional engines or interfaces.

name: Mobile Studio
blurb: Full production environments that fit in your pocket.
